params.command: $p=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'MhwUiValidation\src\MhwModManager.App\bin\Release\net10.0-windows10.0.19041.0'; $exe=Join-Path $p 'MHW Mod Manager.exe'; if(-not(Test-Path $exe)){throw "Missing $exe"}; $proc=Start-Process -FilePath $exe -WorkingDirectory $p -PassThru; Start-Sleep -Seconds 4; Write-Output ("APP_PID="+$proc.Id); Write-Output ("APP_EXITED="+$proc.HasExited)
